rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a day-5 full blastocyst with visible blastocoel, compact ICM and sparse/loose TE consistent with 2AB; minor overinterpretation of contour irregularity and lack of comment on zona thinning.
Strong integration of age, BMI, ovarian response, male factor context, first-cycle status, and especially the very thin endometrium as a major prognostic modifier.

Overall logical and well-structured, with conclusions generally supported by morphology and clinical data; slight inconsistency in describing the embryo as fair-to-good yet also implying intermediate-to-poor territory.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with IVF practice, including SET and avoiding unproven add-ons; minor issue is somewhat specific progesterone advice without enough cycle-context nuance.
Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer counseling, endometrial optimization, luteal support review, cavity assessment, freeze-all consideration, and future-cycle planning.
